title: The Wave That Proved Rogue Waves Are Real
description: For centuries sailors described giant waves out of nowhere, and many scientists doubted them. On New Year's Day 1995, an instrument in the North Sea finally measured one.
comment: Would you ever cross an ocean by ship?

scenes.narration: For centuries, sailors told stories of giant waves that came from nowhere.
Many scientists thought they were exaggerating.
Then, on New Year's Day 1995, an instrument on a gas platform in the North Sea measured one.
It was about 26 metres tall, more than twice the height of the waves around it.
Rogue waves can form when several waves line up and stack their energy into one.
They're rare, but now we know they're real.
